Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG10-001
Rule.Description: Detects price manipulation attempts via negative quantities, zero-price items, or modified totals in checkout

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG10-002
Rule.Description: Detects API rate limit bypass attempts using header manipulation, IP rotation, or parameter tampering

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG10-003
Rule.Description: Detects attempts to skip workflow steps or access later stages without completing prerequisites

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG10-004
Rule.Description: Detects transactions with negative quantities or amounts indicating business logic bypass

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG10-005
Rule.Description: Detects verbose error responses containing stack traces, database details, or internal paths

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG10-006
Rule.Description: Detects usage of weak hash algorithms (MD5, SHA1) in application transactions or certificate signatures

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG10-007
Rule.Description: Detects PII data (SSN, credit card, email) appearing in application logs in cleartext

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG10-008
Rule.Description: Detects storage of sensitive data without encryption at rest in databases, file systems, or object stores
